title: Delegation
description: AGNAP extension to GNAP. A parent agent spawns a child by signing a delegation assertion with the key its own access token is bound to. The child presents the assertion in a normal grant request. The authorization server verifies it, checks that the child's authority is contained in the parent's, and returns a signed receipt. Types only in milestone 1; nothing here is processed yet. The root of this schema is the union of the four artefacts so that generators emit every definition; wire messages reference the definitions directly.

DelegationRef.title: DelegationRef
DelegationRef.description: A stable, opaque identifier for one node in a delegation tree. It survives token rotation, which the token value hash does not. The authorization server issues it and callers treat it as opaque.

DelegationEnvelope.title: DelegationEnvelope
DelegationEnvelope.description: AGNAP extension. Carried in the `delegation` field of a grant request. The assertion is a compact JWS whose payload is `DelegationAssertionClaims`, signed with the parent's bound key.

DelegationAssertionClaims.title: DelegationAssertionClaims
DelegationAssertionClaims.description: Payload of the assertion a parent signs to spawn a child. Verified by the authorization server in the order: aud, iat and exp; jti unused; parent_ref resolves to an active, non-revoked token whose bound key produced the signature and whose value hash matches parent_token_hash when present; child_key_thumbprint equals the requesting key; depth below the policy maximum; child expiry within the parent's; requested access and ceilings contained in the parent's.

parent_token_hash.description: Optional evidence that the parent held the token value when it signed. Not used for lookup because it changes on rotation.

child_key_thumbprint.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint of the child's public key. The child generates its own key pair; the parent only ever sees the public half.

aud.description: The grant endpoint of the authorization server that issued the parent token.

exp.description: Short lived. The assertion is single use; exp bounds how long the jti must be remembered.

DelegationReceipt.title: DelegationReceipt
DelegationReceipt.description: Signed by the authorization server after a child grant is issued. Returned in the grant response and available through introspection. A verifier that trusts the authorization server's key can check the lineage of any token without calling back.

escalated.description: True when the child's authority was not contained in the parent's and the owner approved the widening through GNAP interaction, per `delegation_policy.on_widen`.

DelegationPolicy.title: DelegationPolicy
DelegationPolicy.description: Set by the owner on the root grant. Governs every spawn beneath it.

on_widen.description: What the authorization server does when a child requests authority not contained in its parent's. `reject` fails the grant. `escalate` returns a GNAP interaction so the owner can approve the widening.
